reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 shows twinning in a different alloy (NbTaTiV) without precipitates, E2 and E3 demonstrate L12 precipitate strengthening in an fcc-based eutectic HEA (Al0.7CoCrFeNi) under quasi-static and dynamic shear, and E4 describes adiabatic shear localization in a swaged HEA without precipitates. None of the evidence addresses B2 precipitation in a BCC HfZrTiTa0.53 alloy, the specific aging temperature, or the proposed mechanism linking B2 precipitates to enhanced strain hardening and delayed shear localization under dynamic loading.
